text:
li: Quick sync: proposing a "compact-envelope" contract for ingress that keeps a tiny routing header and a body_ref. Goal: reduce parser work + control cardinality explosion for telemetry & billing. Thoughts? :bulb:
kevin: high level yes, but need clarity on which fields are guaranteed on the fast path vs allowed in late enrichment. Billing needs deterministic billing_key early.
chandra: agree. suggest split into three header tiers: FAST (routing + billing_key), META (tenant_retention, sample_hint), FULL (optional attr map). Parser only decodes FAST; enrichment jobs populate FULL.
maya: sketch of FAST header I had in mind:
```json
{"fast": {"billing_key": "b-tenant-42", "trace_id": "t_abc123", "fast_ts": 1650000000}, "body_ref": "gs://obs/raw/2024/05/xyz.avro", "meta_ref": "gs://obs/meta/2024/05/xyz.json"}
```
sam: tracing callout: trace_id must be stable and propagated by sidecars so joins aren't lost when enrichment executes later. Also include span_hint or parent_id when available so we can stitch without full body.
kevin: retention question: analytics used to TTL at 90 days, billing at 365. If we collapse lanes, we must preserve per-envelope retention. Add a retention_tag and surface it to storage router.
li: cost routing: if sample_hint==true and no billing_key, route to sampled pipeline. If billing_key present -> force full ingest. That avoids double-charge for sampled analytics.
chandra: operational concerns: dedupe/backfill. If body_ref points to external store, enrichers must be idempotent and use body checksums + format_version to detect replay vs original.
maya: will add hdr fields: format_v, body_checksum, retention_tag. Also propose a compact attr-mode enum to control cardinality: ATTR_MODE=minimal|dense|sparse.
kevin: makes sense. Need to quantify p50 parser cost for header-only decode vs full decode. If header-only is cheap we can unify ingress, otherwise keep a proxy split. Can infra team add benchmark? @infra-bot
infra-bot: perf job queued: obs/bench/compact-envelope-header-decode. Result expected in 24h. Link: https://ci.redwood/obs/bench/3851234567
sam: migration plan idea: 1) accept compact envelopes alongside current lanes, 2) enable header-only routing for 5% traffic for non-billing tenants, 3) turn on for billing tenants with explicit override, 4) backfill enrichers to populate FULL for historical queries. Rollback window 1 hour per cohort.
li: analytics query compat: we must keep a join index from body_ref -> enriched attrs to satisfy ad-hoc queries while storage TTL is enforced per retention_tag.
maya: I'll draft an RFC with header schema (FAST+META), attr_mode enum, sampling override rules, and the migration checklist. Owner: @maya. Sam/Kevi n to validate trace stitching and SLOs.
kevin: will run SLO impact calc and post numbers by EOD.
sam: I'll prototype a sidecar passthrough that injects trace_id if missing, and an adjunct stitcher that consumes FAST headers + enriched attrs.
maya: thanks all. tagging this thread for Friday sync. :white_check_mark:
